original_value: The paper introduces a new concept of social entropy and a new concept of social order, both based on the normative framework of society. From these two concepts, typologies (logical and historical) of societies are inferred and examined in their basic features. To these ends, some well-known concepts such as entropy, order, system, network, synergy, norm, autopoieticity, fetality, and complexity are revisited and placed into an integrated framework. The core body of this paper addresses the structure and the mechanism of social entropy, understood as an institutionally working counterpart of social order. Finally, this paper concludes that social entropy is an artefact, like society itself, and acts through people’s behavior.

result.paraphrase: The paper introduces new concepts of social entropy and social order, both grounded in the normative framework of society. To this end, well-known concepts such as entropy, order, system, network, synergy, norm, autopoieticity, fetality, and complexity are revisited and brought together in an integrated framework. The main body of the paper focuses on the structure and mechanism of social entropy, understood as the institutionally functioning counterpart of social order. In conclusion, the paper argues that social entropy is an artefact, like society itself, and operates through human behavior.
